title: The Coffee Landscape: a UNESCO site since 2011
goal: Describe the coffee landscape of Colombia and how coffee is made with the passive *se* (*se recoge*, *se secan*).
grammar: the passive se construction, applied to the Coffee Cultural Landscape

items: I can describe how something is done with the passive *se* (*se recoge*, *se secan*).
I can say what UNESCO recognised in 2011 and what the chivas and the bahareque houses are.
I can use the new words for the coffee plantation, bahareque, the chiva and to pulp.
